description: Fork of exp064 (val=1.6997 @ 8K). Single change: split the joint Q/K TinyMultiHeadLut (n_outputs=2*d_qk=64) into two independent LUTs (q_lut and k_lut, each n_outputs=d_qk=32). Param-invariant (each LUT half the size, two of them). Hypothesis: independent anchor sampling for Q and K lets them attend to different sub-features of the input.
